rows.note: The charged sag uses the inradius as a circular base. The triangle is not that circle.
A sphere through the three vertices rises about four times as far. It is not charged.
Mean sag is the spherical-cap mean over that circle. It is 0.5036 of the crown, which is why 3*crown/R is about twice the note's percent.
The note's equilateral force is smaller than 011b by sqrt(3). This filing does not replace the briefed global or film factor. Yield, Euler, local and Perry are reported both ways.
The metallised layer still has no opened density. The sag kilograms are added to the film only.
Thickness follows s, so the film factor is 1 at every bay in this table. The filed card had held the 2.04 m thickness.
